digest.component_or_area: bridge provider test harness (git subprocess isolation)
propositions: Test test_five_environment_matrix_has_identical_results_without_gh fails on dev hosts with ambient GIT_CONFIG_* command-scope injection (safe.bareRepository=explicit) but passes in CI, caused by harness git helpers inheriting os.environ uncleaned

Bridge harness helpers git()/bare_git() in test_run_reconcile_bridge.py fail to hold out command-scope git config env vars, allowing ambient host injection (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_*/VALUE_*) to reach git subprocesses

Sibling test files test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py and test_bridge_runner_install_paths_heldout.py exhibit the same class of failure (21 total failures) due to shared harness git subprocess inheritance

Harness must scrub GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_*, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_*, GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS from os.environ and pin GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null + GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 in git helpers and runner_env to isolate bridge runs from ambient host git config
